title: Trevor Paglen's book on black-project patches

tellings.quote: it basically what it is is a compilation of black project patches

plain: The artist and writer Trevor Paglen put together a book that is basically a collection of the embroidered patches worn by teams on black projects, the US military's most secret programmes. Matthew Brown, presented on the episode as a Pentagon whistleblower, brings it up with Jesse Michels as a source he has looked at, as a window into programmes that are otherwise hidden.
